questions.questionText: A power supply of electromotive force (e.m.f.) 50V and negligible internal resistance is connected in series with resistors of resistance 100Ω and 5Ω, as shown. 100 Ω 5 Ω V 50 V A

A single sheet of aluminium foil is folded twice to produce a stack of four sheets. The total thickness of the stack of sheets is measured to be (0.80 ± 0.02)mm. This measurement is made using a digital caliper with a zero error of (−0.20 ± 0.02)mm. What is the percentage uncertainty in the calculated thickness of a single sheet?

In an experiment to determine the acceleration of free fall g, a ball bearing is held by an electromagnet. When the current to the electromagnet is switched off, a clock starts and the ball bearing falls. After falling a distance h, the ball bearing strikes a switch to stop the clock which measures the time t of the fall. If systematic errors cause t and h to be measured incorrectly, which error must cause g to –2 appear greater than 9.81ms ?

options.A: h measured as being smaller than it actually is and t is measured correctly
options.B: h measured as being smaller than it actually is and t measured as being larger than it actually is
options.C: h measured as being larger than it actually is and t measured as being larger than it actually is
options.D: h is measured correctly and t measured as being smaller than it actually is

questions.questionText: A stone is thrown horizontally from the top of a cliff. Air resistance is negligible. Which graph shows the variation with time of the vertical component of the stone’s velocity?

options.C: D velocity velocity 0 0 0 0 time time

questions.questionText: A sprinter runs a 100m race in a straight line. He accelerates from the starting block at a constant –2 –1 acceleration of 2.5ms to reach his maximum speed of 10ms . He maintains this speed until he crosses the finish line. Which time does it take the sprinter to run the race?

A firework rocket is fired vertically upwards. The fuel burns and produces a constant upwards force on the rocket. After 5 seconds there is no fuel left. Air resistance is negligible. What is the acceleration before and after 5 seconds? before 5 seconds after 5 seconds

options.C: increasing constant
options.D: increasing zero

questions.questionText: Trolley X, moving along a horizontal frictionless track, collides with a stationary trolley Y. The two trolleys become attached and move off together. Which statement about this interaction is correct?

options.A: Some of the kinetic energy of trolley X is changed to momentum in the collision.
options.B: Some of the momentum of trolley X is changed to kinetic energy in the collision.
options.C: Trolley X loses some of its momentum as heat in the collision.
options.D: Trolley X shares its momentum with trolley Y but some of its kinetic energy is lost.

questions.questionText: An astronaut throws a stone with a horizontal velocity near to the Moon’s surface. Which row describes the horizontal and vertical forces acting on the stone after release? horizontal force vertical force

options.C: zero constant
options.D: zero decreasing

questions.questionText: Newton’s third law of motion is often summarised as ‘Every action (force) has an equal and opposite reaction.’

options.A: the pull of the book on the Earth
options.B: the pull of the Earth on the book
options.C: the push of the book on the table
options.D: the push of the table on the book

options.A: B P P ladder ladder wall wall R R W W ground ground
options.C: D P P ladder ladder wall wall R R W W ground ground

options.B: It loses both elastic potential energy and kinetic energy.

questions.questionText: Which statement is not valid?

options.A: Current is the speed of the charged particles that carry it.
options.B: Electromotive force (e.m.f.) is the energy converted to electrical energy from other forms per unit charge.
options.C: The potential difference (p.d.) between two points is the work done per unit charge when moving charge from one point to the other.
options.D: The resistance between two points is the p.d. between the two points per unit current.
